crypto_headlines.title: Arthur Hayes: $50K is the next real test for BTC
crypto_headlines.summary: Hayes says BTC decisively broke below its previous local low, and if the Nasdaq keeps falling, $50K is the next level to watch. BTC was back near $60.6K Sunday morning.

crypto_headlines.title: Binance BTC funding rate flips negative
crypto_headlines.summary: CryptoQuant's Darkfost says negative funding on Binance can be an early sign of a reversal.

crypto_headlines.title: Coinbase BTC premium negative for 60 straight days
crypto_headlines.summary: US buyers on Coinbase have been paying less than offshore markets for two months running.

crypto_headlines.title: ARK pulls its CoinDesk 20 crypto ETF filings
crypto_headlines.summary: Cathie Wood's ARK told the SEC it does not intend to proceed with its CoinDesk 20 ETF or the no-Bitcoin version.

crypto_headlines.title: Russia opens BTC, ETH and USDT trading to retail on approved exchanges
crypto_headlines.summary: Under new rules, retail investors in Russia can legally trade BTC, ETH and USDT on approved platforms.

crypto_headlines.title: Pump.fun ends external wallet login on Nov 30
crypto_headlines.summary: Former Mt. Gox CEO Mark Karpeles criticized the change for asking users to paste private keys into the site.

doginal_news.title: Black Friday backpack sold out, community says
doginal_news.summary: @icyjetfuel says the backpack from the Black Friday swag sale sold out and the purse is next. @doginaldogs reposted it.

doginal_news.title: AGS-graded Doginal Dogs slabs, Atlas included
doginal_news.summary: @PeteSake813 got his graded Doginal Dogs cards back from AGS, Atlas included, and @DDLTCG reposted it.

doginal_news.title: Rip or keep sealed? Legends box debate
doginal_news.summary: The community is split on ripping sealed Legends boxes for pulls and gameplay or keeping them sealed.

doginal_news.title: PIRB: Nasdaq and NYSE data still on the Pyth Marketplace
doginal_news.summary: PIRB quoted a community post noting that Nasdaq and NYSE data on the Pyth Marketplace and Pyth's RWA perps lead are still in place through the dump. PYTH was up about 6.6% over 24h Sunday morning, per CoinGecko.

notes: No new original posts from @doginaldogs, @DDLTCG or @PythNetwork in the last 24 hours (reposts only). Community items are listed above. Still no news on Toot, Atlas or Boogie drops or restocks.
